name: MMMU-Pro
protocol: MMMU-Pro fixed release; overall score is the official average of Standard-10 and Vision settings. Original MMMU and later dynamic leaderboard configurations remain separate.

explanation.en: The headline score is the average of accuracy in the Standard-10 and Vision settings. These settings are not mixed with original MMMU accuracy.
explanation.zh: headline score 是 Standard-10 和 Vision 两种 setting accuracy 的平均值。这两个 setting 不和原始 MMMU accuracy 混合。

summary.en: MMMU-Pro strengthens multimodal academic reasoning by filtering text-solvable items, expanding answer choices, and adding a vision-only setting.
summary.zh: MMMU-Pro 通过过滤仅靠文字可解的题目、增加选项并加入 vision-only setting，强化多模态 academic reasoning 测试。

task_format.en: The model solves the same broad academic task style under Standard-10 and Vision formats; the Vision format embeds the question and options in the image.
task_format.zh: 模型在 Standard-10 和 Vision 两种格式下完成 academic task；Vision 格式会把问题和选项直接放进图片。
